notes_for_us: A car game has no car. path-road-vehicle builds the road and nothing in the catalogue represents the vehicle driving on it — let alone its interior, which here is a fully specified space with pedals, stalks and a lever the player watches.

The prompt asks for a suburb and a clutch pedal. layout-intake's rule about splitting extent from detail is the right answer and has no field: the split can only be described in notes, and nothing downstream is obliged to act on it.

Racing versus Vehicle Sim turns on whether there is a lap or a finish. Here there are races inside a persistent open world, so the test returns both answers, and which genre leads decides whether an entire city is routed P6.
Much of the prompt is copyright avoidance — renamed brands, renamed songs. That is a naming rule over everything in the build, and the handoff has nowhere to record a rule.

notes: Roleplay & Avatar Sim leads on the Animal Sim preset: the player is the creature, so there is no settlement and no housing. RPG is named second for the stats-and-powers progression, but it contributed no spatial option — its rows are towns, mob nests and level gates, none of which the prompt asks for.

Dinosaurs are large. Nothing in the handoff can say that the dens, gaps and clearings need to be sized for a creature rather than a 4-stud avatar, and every dimension in the system assumes the avatar.

notes_for_us: Naming RPG second was correct by the mixing rule and bought nothing: stats and powers are progression, which step 0 routes to mechanics, so the second genre's whole contribution was a slug in a list. The rule that a secondary genre is free is true, but 'load it for its options' was wasted work here.

The Animal Sim note in the Roleplay file — an animal sim has no town, it is wilderness-open and den-shelter — is the single line that classified this prompt, and it is buried in the genre notes rather than anywhere near the preset table.
An owner-only admin panel is a common Roblox request and lands nowhere: it is UI, it is permissions, and it has no spatial footprint at all.
Nothing in the system carries creature scale. A map for dinosaurs needs wider paths, taller clearances and bigger dens, and the only size control available is the four-value scale band.

skill_gap.name: no non-avatar body scale
